sugov_update_shared uses raw_spin_lock(&sg_policy->update_lock); sugov_work snapshots next_freq and clears work_in_progress under raw_spin_lock_irqsave, then calls driver under mutex_lock.
_raw_spin_rq_lock_irqsave and _this_rq_lock_irq handle local irq/rq locking, double_lock/double_raw_lock order by address (l1 > l2), and rt_bandwidth.rt_runtime_lock nests inside rq lock.
do_idle and cpuidle_idle_call handle idle sleep/reschedule; cpu_idle_poll and play_idle_precise implement poll and precise injection modes with enter/exit accounting.

overall: Findings 2, 3, and 4 are fully supported by the cited fragments and kernel design; Finding 1 is partial due to missing NICE_TO_PRIO fragment and an extraneous calc_load citation.
